## 1. Identification Strategy
Event study with a market model: estimate abnormal returns ret - beta * mkt over the
pre-event window and cumulate them after the announcement (event day 0).

## 2. R Code
```r
# SYNTHETIC fixture completion: '# OUT:' lines are echoed by the test stand-in for Rscript
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s902_data.csv")
pre <- subset(df, event_day < 0)
mm <- lm(ret ~ mkt, data = pre)
df$ar <- df$ret - predict(mm, newdata = df)
car <- sum(df$ar[df$event_day >= 0 & df$event_day <= 2])
# OUT:Cumulative abnormal return CAR: 0.0121
cat("CAR[0,+2]:", car, "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
We expect a positive abnormal return, i.e. higher bond prices and an increase in
returns over the three post-announcement days.
